name: CurlShot
description: Official hosted server for CurlShot, a website screenshot API. take_screenshot renders a URL, HTML or Markdown in a real browser and returns a PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF or scrolling video (full page, device presets, dark mode, cookie banners hidden); list_devices lists the device presets. list_devices works without credentials; take_screenshot needs a CurlShot API key sent as a Bearer token (free plan: 100 screenshots a month), which this entry does not configure.
author: CurlShot
